purpose: Lets a person search for a GilbVeda type and pick one from a short list with planes, definitions, a detail view and a note when more terms match than are shown.
namedChanges: The default `search = searchLiveTerms` (line 151) is removed: `search: TypeSearchFn` is required.

`BLANK_QUERY_REACH` (line 176, the first value of the `reach` state; in the source it comes from `src/lib/base/typeSearch.ts` line 553, built from the environment setting `VITE_MIN_ONTOLOGY_QUERY`) is the new required prop `blankReach: string`. It is always shown until the first answer, so it is required, with no fallback text.

`readTermDefinition` (line 48 import, line 257 call) is the reader from `TermDefinitionContext` of the `type-term-popover` unit; `TypeTermPopover` and the `TermDefinition` type come from that unit too. A missing provider throws.

`TypeIcon` (`./recordIcons`; lines 364-368 in the detail view and 483-489 in a row) is the new optional prop `renderTypeIcon(option, className)`, called with the same class strings; when absent nothing is drawn. The wrapper elements around it are unchanged. (`typeId={o.spec?.id ?? "note"}` and `typeName` are the host's to derive from the option.)

library.title: Type chooser (GilbVeda type search)
library.note: Search and pick a GilbVeda type; the Plan card's Type line is plan-type-field. For records take record-picker.
